description: What is a US men's 10 in EU, UK, Japan or Mondopoint? Convert shoe sizes between systems for men, women and kids, through foot length. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

group.description: men, women or kids: picks the US and UK scales.

size.description: The size as written on the label or chart. Numbers take decimals, commas or fractions ("9.5", "9,5", "9½", "9 1/2", "42 2/3" for EU thirds, "10.5C" or "3Y" for US kids).

womenScale.description: US women's scale: common (men's + 1.5, default) or fia (men's + 1).

name: convert_shoe_size
title: Convert a shoe size
